🧠 Crypto News Brief: Hot US inflation and an AI-led tech rout dragged bitcoin toward $80K and flushed nearly $1B in leverage, while Washington lost its crypto point man and Europe tightened oversight of stablecoins. 📉 Bitcoin Slips Below $81K as Hot CPI Sparks Global Risk-Off Bitcoin fell about 3.6% to roughly $80,760 and ether dropped 6.5% after US inflation came in at 3.7%, reviving fears of higher-for-longer rates. The selloff spread from Wall Street's AI trade to Asia, where Korea's Kospi plunged 8% and Japan's Nikkei slid 5%. Nearly $1B in leveraged crypto bets were liquidated, mostly longs, and US spot bitcoin ETFs logged fresh outflows. Read full story 🏛️ White House Crypto Chief Patrick Witt Exits as Clarity Act Stalls Patrick Witt's temporary detail as executive director of the White House Crypto Council has ended, the administration confirmed, with no successor named. He is the third senior crypto official to leave this year, departing while the Clarity Act remains stuck after failing a Senate procedural vote on Sept. 15. In remarks published the same day, Witt said the White House was exploring budget-neutral ways to add bitcoin to the Strategic Bitcoin Reserve. More details 🇪🇺 EU Names Circle's USDC Its First "Significant" Stablecoin Under MiCA The European Banking Authority classified USDC as the first significant e-money token among 45 notified under MiCA. From Nov. 12, oversight of USDC's own funds, reserves, liquidity and redemption plans shifts from France's ACPR to the EBA, bringing stricter capital and reserve requirements for the world's second-largest stablecoin. Read more 🏦 Kraken Parent Payward Agrees to Buy EU-Licensed Saldo Bank Payward signed a definitive agreement to acquire Lithuania-licensed Saldo Bank, positioning it to become the first crypto company to own a European bank. Pending regulatory approval and expected to close in 2027, the deal would let Payward offer EU clients interest-bearing deposits, loans, cards and euro payments across Saldo's passported markets. See details 🔐 Ledger Pulls Wallets From 7 Asian Markets Over Spy-Chip Implants Ledger told resellers in six Southeast Asian countries and Hong Kong to halt sales and pull devices while it investigates tampered wallets fitted with implants that captured seed phrases and sent them over a cellular link. ———————————————————————————

## Top Stories

**BTC** $80,822 (-3.3%) | **ETH** $2,359 (-5.9%) | **SOL** $102 (-5.0%)

* Bitcoin falls [below $81K](https://www.chooserich.live/story/bitcoin-falls-long-liquidations-uxufhb7) as US September CPI rises [3.7%](https://x.com/TreeNewsFeed/status/2110347404268728440) year over year, above the 3.6% estimate

* S&P 500 falls [1.22%](https://x.com/BullTheoryio/status/2110424813676482652) to 7,710.43, its biggest drop in over two months — US stocks shed [$660B](https://x.com/BullTheoryio/status/2110389555706962038)

* Spot bitcoin ETFs see [$261.5M](https://www.chooserich.live/story/bitcoin-ether-etfs-outflows-aa3eicx) in net outflows

* White House says US is exploring ways to [accumulate more Bitcoin](https://www.chooserich.live/story/white-house-accumulate-bitcoin-da9ha2d)

* Polygon Labs completes Coinme buyout, gaining payments coverage in [48 US states](https://www.chooserich.live/story/polygon-labs-acquires-coinme-hzzpyh6)

* Strive raises [$500M](https://www.chooserich.live/story/strive-stock-offering-buy-bitcoin-bsdkauq) via new SATS preferred shares to buy more bitcoin

* Fed funds futures put [66% odds](https://x.com/bespokeinvest/status/2110439064373535129) on no rate hike at the October 28 FOMC

* BlackRock posts Q3 revenue of [$7.75B](https://x.com/wallstengine/status/2110309824000852266) and $205B in net inflows, beating estimates

* Anthropic tells investors it turned profitable in Q3 with revenue near [$17B](https://www.chooserich.live/story/anthropic-reports-profitability-revenue-ipo-si3vu82)

* Strive buys [$235M](https://www.chooserich.live/story/strive-buys-bitcoin-pexi6e2) worth of BTC

* Apple hits [$5T](https://x.com/barronsonline/status/2110476593810272559) market cap even as the rest of the tech trade falters

* TSMC posts record profit for a [sixth straight quarter](https://www.chooserich.live/story/tsmc-record-profit-ai-demand-7as9t4t) on AI demand

* Brooklyn DA and FBI shut down [241 crypto fraud sites](https://www.chooserich.live/story/fbi-brooklyn-da-crypto-scam-websites-2i9b77c) tied to Eastern Europe

* Reports claim Richard Heart was [arrested in Turkey](https://www.chooserich.live/story/richard-heart-arrested-turkey-86ae5ze)
